messages:
lily: quick flag — saw a small but consistent token bump in staging during the canary today. looks like a resume + truncated-chunk interaction after node preempt.

ben: tl;dr? customer visible?

lily: not customer-visible in staging, but pattern: client opens stream -> serving pod preempted -> router reroutes to new pod -> client reconnects with same resume_token -> first pod had truncated the mid-chunk and never reconciled provisional tokens -> ledger ends up counting both provisional and final.

morgan: ah, resume_token equality across hops bites us. current meter keys on resume_token only, so shard-local provisional entries are blind to origin.

raj: options: (A) extend provisional key to (resume_token, hop_id) so different origins don't collide, (B) emit a tombstone on reroute to remove provisional from the old hop, (C) require a final session_confirm from serving node that authoritatively commits tokens.

ben: (A) sounds clean but schema-heavy. increases cardinality and will blow some joins. migration pain.

morgan: (B) minimal but races: tombstone could be delayed/lost and we'd still have stale provisional until TTL. could help if tombstones are reliable.

lily: (C) is operationally simple: don't move provisional->confirmed until session_confirm arrives with resolved origin. provisional TTL garbage collects stale items. UX downside: temporary inflated usage in console.

raj: another idea: reconcile job that consumes router traces + ledger provisional table and emits corrective adjustments (debit event) when it detects a truncated fragment recreated on another hop.

morgan: +1 for reconcile job — less invasive schema changes, gives us telemetry to decide between A/B/C. we can also surface reconcile findings in console.

lily: sample reconcile event we discussed: ```reconcile_event: {"session":"s-42","orig_hop":"pod-7","new_hop":"pod-13","resume_token":"rxy-9","action":"tombstone"}```

ben: console changes: show provisional vs committed token counts per session, add a "reroute" badge, and a support filter for "reconciled adjustments" so ops can triage customers.

devops-bot: ticket created: BILL-789 reconcile job + console tile queued for prioritization.

raj: experiment plan: enable tombstone emission for 1% traffic, enable reconcile job in dry-run for 100% (no writes), and enable hop-tagging (A) for 0.5% traffic. collect metrics: pct_resumes_with_hop_mismatch, avg_provisional_lifetime, double_charge_incidents.

morgan: set alert if double_charge_incidents > 0.3% of resumed sessions.

lily: I'll prototype hop header in router today, wire minimal reconciler in staging, and post smoke results. thanks. :thumbsup:
